symptom: a stored Send external object described as `-- Unsupported action: Microflows$SendExternalObject`; drop + create of that flow (the route MDL-V1-REBUILD recommends) passed check and exec and wrote it without the send, so the external entity was never saved again
cause: no grammar/AST/builder/reader/writer/formatter for Microflows$SendExternalObject / DeleteExternalObject; the reader fell through to UnsupportedAction, which the writer deliberately drops, and nothing compared a rebuilt body against the stored one's unexpressible activities
insight: Test an OData write activity without network: a consumed service takes a LOCAL $metadata file, and `create external entities` then gives a real external entity for mx check. mx check names the activity ('Send external object activity …') even when it reports a semantic error, which proves the BSON shape loads. Measured matrix (11.12.6): rollback/custom/custom-without-rollback build, continue is CE6035, nanoflow is CE0009, a non-updatable entity is CE9435. To exercise an UnsupportedAction guard end to end, build a variant with one reader case removed — the stored activity then reads as unsupported, exactly the reporter's state. Side finding, not fixed here: the importer reads Capabilities annotations written with the vocabulary ALIAS as not creatable/updatable, while mxbuild resolves them (CE6630).
